updates.reason: Release metadata, browser lifecycle, cross-surface reminders and manual downloads must preserve their version and failure boundaries.

notifications.reason: Closed-panel observation, terminal validation, deduplication and account isolation cross worker and browser permission lifetimes.

sharing.reason: ShareDialog and its publication adapters have no reachable mounted disclosure action; protocol checks do not establish a product sharing journey.

privacy.reason: Preference consent, scope isolation and local file deletion cross durable account boundaries.

dictation.reason: Microphone activation and transcript insertion require independent explicit actions and cancellation.

identity.reason: Authorization and identity fences control access to every conversation.

quickChat.reason: Primary user conversation surface and its independent delivery lifecycle.

workspace.reason: Mounted compact conversation actions edit, regenerate and fork retained history.

pageContext.reason: Explicit tab capture crosses a privacy and permission boundary.

appearance.reason: Preferences must survive surface changes without disrupting work.

extension.reason: Packaged lifecycle, worker transport and trusted-storage boundaries.

sdk.reason: SDK port/protocol verification supports journeys but cannot establish user outcomes.

rendering.reason: Storybook and axe verify rendering/accessibility; visibility alone is not a journey.

guidance.reason: Introduction is a host-controlled transient stepper; popup delegates to sidepanel/options. Rendered guidance supports entry into journeys without a separate durable workflow.

offlineBridge.reason: The independent SDK offline document bridge has no mounted product journey; bridge protocol checks cannot certify chat recovery.

attachments.reason: Quick composer explicitly configures attachment service and submits files with one user turn.

automations.reason: Saved workflows and cloud schedules must retain their own identity across reload and failure.

httpSubmission.reason: ConversationsController HTTP receipt adapter is not mounted by App routes; its tests do not prove the Loro user path.
